item.title: Splat 1.0.16
item.description:
- **Smaller.** Splat takes about 35 MB on disk instead of 55 MB, and the download is about a quarter smaller. - **Less memory.** The engine that draws formulas and diagrams ends after two minutes without a new one, the visual formula editor a minute after it closed, and the image decoder after a minute without a picture; what they drew stays. Pictures take the pixels they cover on screen and decode again when they show larger. - **Faster typing in large documents.** Above 2 MB, the preview catches up after a keystroke many times sooner, as only the changed paragraphs are parsed and laid out again.
Something wrong or missing? [Report it on GitHub](https://github.com/sventmueller/splat/issues/new/choose).
